=== Root 33 · Act I: The Landing === Themed wins are locked until Act II. Act II: The Monolith begins at the end of a turn once anyone has 10+ VP, or after round 4.

Root 33 story (Act I: The Landing): Act I, 'The Landing', opens after the prologue with a short, skippable speech-bubble scene: Expedition 33 comes ashore on the Continent, the landing goes badly, and the survivors regroup. The Monolith Number appears on the Monolith (33 minus the top score). No themed win can happen in Act I. Nothing on the board changes.

Root 33 story (Act I: The Landing): At setup, if Esquie is seated: Florrie is placed at Stone Wave Cliffs with 2 guard warriors from the Nevron host's supply under a Lampmaster badge (fewer if the host's supply runs short; the guard counter equals the number placed).

Root 33 story (Act I: The Landing): At setup, if Esquie is seated: a cosmetic François decoy badge sits at Esquie's Nest. It has no guard warrior and holds no rock. When Esquie enters the Nest while it is up, he barks that this is not Florrie, the badge points him to Stone Wave Cliffs, and it is removed. It also goes when Act I ends.
